notes.title: 《ReEarth》7.23.2025 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Update Announcement

Dear Players,

Thank you all for your continued support. We are excited to bring you the latest game update. The details of this update are as follows:

1. Add a power system. Constructing buildings will consume power! Buildings without sufficient power will not work!
2. Adjust the values of some units.

Additionally, we will be adding the usernames of players who actively provided bug feedback and suggestions to our credits. We appreciate their contributions to improving our game!
If you encounter any issues during gameplay, please contact us via our social media or send your feedback to our game support email.


Email address: 3680314621@qq.com  

QQ Group: 975755335 

Happy gaming!  

CrazyDog

notes.title: 《ReEarth》31.7.2024 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Update Announcement

Dear Players,

Thank you for your continued support. We are excited to bring you the latest game update. Here are the details of the new content:

1. Fixed the bug where game settings could not be saved.
2. Added unit exit direction to factory silhouettes in build mode.
3. Optimized mini-map orientation.
4. Fixed the laser turret range bug.
5. Fixed bugs preventing certain achievements from being unlocked.
6. Fixed various UI display bugs.
7. Reduced the collision size of all units to improve pathfinding.
8. Optimized the pathfinding logic for Zerg.
9. Adjusted various game values.
10. Added a new tutorial level.

Additionally, we will be adding the usernames of players who have actively provided bug feedback and suggestions to our credits. We appreciate their contributions to improving our game!

If you encounter any issues while playing, please contact us through our social media or send us feedback via email.

Email: 3680314621@qq.com  
Discord: (https://discord.gg/sSnYyYTy]Click Here

Happy gaming!

CrazyDog
